title: Supra MK4 in the Night Studio at 2 AM
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
statement: Ten minutes in, you'll forget you didn't want to.
description:
In the quiet of the Night Studio at 2 AM, a chalk grey Toyota Supra MK4 rests under the dim indoor glow while the city outside sleeps and only your screens remain on. Drifting softly through the space are two hours of warm synth pads, a soft deep bass, and a gentle beat, music only without distraction. This calm ambient electronic sound is here to keep you company, giving you a peaceful space to work, study, and relax.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.

#ceofocus #deepfocus #musicforwork #focusmusic #supramk4
